doc.title: Bill Watrous interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 26, 1999

title: Closing thanks and the Monk nickname
summary: Mutual goodbyes, with a joke about his wife calling him Monk.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: All right. Well best of luck to you in the future, and I’m sure we’ll cross paths again.
Monk, I honestly and truly hope this isn’t the last time that we get together, because I’ve taken a sincere liking to you as a person and as a musician.
I believe in what you’re doing and I just like anybody else that’s called Monk.
Because my wife calls me Monk.
We must be all right guys you know that.
I think so. Thank you very much.
